description: This source file contains unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component of the OpenClaw project, testing functionality related to workspace path display, URL resolution, agent file bootstrap process, and bootstrap safety checks.

classes.name: AgentWorkspaceTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple unit tests for the AgentWorkspace utility functions.

methods.name: `display path uses tilde for home`
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath function correctly uses tilde for the user's home directory.

methods.name: `resolve workspace URL expands tilde`
methods.description: Verifies that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands a tilde-prefixed path.

methods.name: `agents URL appends filename`
methods.description: Ensures agentsURL correctly appends the filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: `bootstrap creates agents file when missing`
methods.description: Tests that the bootstrap function creates necessary files if they are missing.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents`
methods.description: Checks that bootstrapSafety rejects a non-empty folder lacking agent files.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety allows existing agents file`
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrapSafety approves a workspace if an agents file already exists.

methods.name: `bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content`
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap skips creating bootstrap file if the workspace already contains other content.

methods.name: `needs bootstrap false when identity already set`
methods.description: Confirms that the system recognizes that bootstrap is not needed when identity information is already present.
